choices.text: Kernels and copies in the same stream run in the order they were issued.
`cudaMemcpyAsync` from pageable (not pinned) host memory cannot overlap with a kernel the way a pinned copy can.
`cudaStreamWaitEvent(s2, e)` makes later work in `s2` wait until `e`, recorded in `s1`, has completed, without blocking the CPU.
Putting each kernel in its own stream always makes a program faster.
The default (legacy) stream overlaps freely with all other streams.
